name: Insight Dashboard for JMeter
description: A real-time, collapsible per-transaction results listener for JMeter: live stat cards, response-time charts, a tree table (expand a transaction to see its individual requests, SLA threshold highlighting, throughput/P90/P95/P99), CSV/Excel export, a structured, numbered performance report (test overview, slowest transactions/requests, failures, error codes, SLA compliance) that populates automatically as soon as a test finishes, and an AI-assisted Observations section, Chat tab, and failure explanations (via a local Gemini CLI or Claude Code install) — all computed directly from the test data, with the AI layer entirely optional.
